title: Total Quality Management: Main Exam, 22 January 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / bachelor of Science in Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain the key phases of evolution in relation to developments in quality management.
Evaluate the importance of quality in the modern world.
Analyse the determinants of customer satisfaction.
Employee involvement is one of the key principles that influence the success of TQM programmes. Extrapolate.
Examine the various types of costs associated with internal failure costs.
Analyse the concept of cost of quality, explaining its dimensions, and provide relevant examples.
Examine the common steps involved in the implementation of TQM programmes.
Evaluate the factors that can influence the successful implementation of a Six Sigma programme.
Analyse the elements of variation in quality of products in a typical manufacturing industry.
Benchmarking is a key approach in TQM. Discuss the various types of benchmarking that are applicable to business organizations.
Examine the limitations associated with business process re-engineering (BPR) as one of the current approaches in TQM.
Many organizations in Kenya are seeking ISO 9001 certification. Discuss the potential benefits such an organization may derive from certification.
Assess the benefits of using control charts.
